title: Iran expands attacks on Gulf states after intense US strikes
facts: Iran and the United States exchanged military fire for the third time in a single week over control of the Strait of Hormuz. [cite: 257]
The 2026 war between the United States and Iran began with surprise US-Israeli strikes on February 28. [cite: 257]
The crew of a commercial ship in the Strait of Hormuz abandoned the vessel after an Iranian attack caused it to catch fire. [cite: 257]
Iran's Revolutionary Guards declared the Strait of Hormuz closed until the end of American interventions in the region. [cite: 257]
The US military's Central Command asserted that the Strait of Hormuz remained open to all vessels seeking lawful transit. [cite: 257]
Iranian state media reported that at least 10 enemy projectiles hit Qeshm Island on the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday evening. [cite: 257]
Iranian state media reported strikes on the island of Farur that killed a telecommunications worker and wounded two others. [cite: 257]
Kuwait reported damage to three land border posts in the north following an attack. [cite: 257]
An offshore drilling platform in Kuwait was targeted by a hostile drone, resulting in one injury. [cite: 257]
The US military stated it responded to Iranian actions with strikes on approximately 140 targets. [cite: 257]
One Iranian soldier was reportedly killed in the southern city of Jask during the US strikes. [cite: 257]
The Jordanian government stated that three Iranian missiles fell inside its territory. [cite: 257]
Oman summoned the Iranian ambassador and issued a formal protest after Iran's Revolutionary Guards struck Omani territory. [cite: 257]
An Iranian attack on a Cyprus-flagged container ship in the Strait of Hormuz left one Indian sailor missing. [cite: 257]
Omani authorities rescued 23 crew members from a commercial ship approximately 17 kilometers east of Oman. [cite: 257]
